categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in industrial automation and intelligent manufacturing solutions, including control systems, instrumentation, industrial software, operation and maintenance services, and S2B platform business. It serves multiple industries such as chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceuticals, energy, metallurgy, and emerging sectors like oil and gas and robotics. The company also provides integrated industrial automation projects, technical consulting, and advanced control and optimization technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include industrial AI with proprietary large models such as the Time-Series Pre-trained Transformer (TPT) for process automation and the Hyper Graph Transformer (HGT) for business automation. The company develops software-defined, fully digital, cloud-native control systems (UCS), intelligent operation management and control systems (OMC), safety instrumented systems (SIS), compressor control systems (CCS), and advanced instrumentation based on Ethernet-APL technology. It integrates AI, robotics, and multi-agent systems to enable autonomous operation and intelligent decision-making in industrial processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in process industries including chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceuticals, energy, metallurgy, building materials, paper, and emerging sectors like oil and gas and liquor manufacturing. The company serves over 35,000 customers across more than 50 sub-industries, including major state-owned enterprises and leading private companies such as Sinopec, PetroChina, Wanhua Chemical, and Wuliangye. It also targets international markets with clients like Saudi Aramco, Petronas, Mitsubishi Chemical, and Holcim.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive coverage across all major regions including East China, North China, Central China, Northwest, Southwest, South China, and Northeast. It has a growing international presence with subsidiaries and operations in Southeast Asia, Middle East, Central Asia, Europe, Americas, Japan, South Korea, and Africa. It has established 200+ PlantMate 5S stores domestically and overseas to enhance local service and customer engagement.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial automation supply chain. It develops and manufactures core automation hardware and software products, provides integrated engineering solutions, and offers after-sales services and digital platforms that connect suppliers and customers. It also invests in upstream R&D and collaborates with ecosystem partners to enhance product and service offerings.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on advancing industrial AI technologies, including large-scale AI models for process and business automation, AI-driven robotics, and digital twin platforms. The company emphasizes the '1+2+N' industrial AI architecture integrating factory operating systems, core AI models, and specialized industrial applications. It invests heavily in R&D (over 10% of revenue), fosters ecosystem partnerships, and pursues international expansion. Future R&D includes AI-enhanced control algorithms, multi-agent systems, and green low-carbon technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of industrial automation equipment, instrumentation, and industrial software licenses. The company also earns from engineering project integration, technical consulting, operation and maintenance services, and a growing subscription-based membership model for industrial software. Additionally, it operates an online and offline integrated industrial goods and services platform (PlantMart and PlantMate) that supports recurring revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's industrial automation market, with a domestic market share of 40.4% in distributed control systems (DCS), ranking first for 14 consecutive years. It leads market share in chemical, petrochemical, building materials, and paper industries. It faces competition from traditional industrial automation firms and emerging AI and IT companies entering the industrial AI space. Its comprehensive AI-driven product ecosystem and strong customer base provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 9.14 billion, a 6.02% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.12 billion, up 1.38%. Excluding foreign exchange impacts, net profit growth was 9.60%, and net profit excluding non-recurring items grew 20.26%. The company maintains strong R&D investment at 10.7% of revenue and has total assets exceeding RMB 18.3 billion. International business revenue grew 118.27%, accounting for 8.25% of total revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through pioneering industrial AI integration, offering the world's first universal control system (UCS) with software-defined, cloud-native architecture that significantly reduces costs and complexity. Its proprietary industrial AI large models (TPT and HGT) enable autonomous, intelligent operation and business automation, improving efficiency, safety, and sustainability. The integrated AI and robotics solutions enhance operational intelligence and reduce human intervention. Its comprehensive ecosystem, extensive data resources, and deep industry expertise provide customers with tailored, high-value digital transformation solutions.
